criteria.title: Divergence-free Fourier 기저
criteria.text:
2π 주기영역에서k·ûk=0, û−k=conj(ûk), Pk=I−kkᵀ/|k|²를사용한다. k=0은별도mean equation이다. 합격: 제약이초
기·각accepted step에서유지되고pressure 회복에div f가포함된다. 이branch의periodic domain을whole-space 논문
해와혼동하지않는다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
criteria.acceptanceScope: The independent 2pi-periodic Fourier Galerkin branch still validates divergence, conjugate symmetry and zero mode initially and at each accepted step, with div f in pressure recovery. The new bounded accepted-state history is independently checked to leave the final integrator coefficients bit-for-bit unchanged. This domain is explicitly separate from the paper whole-space field.

criteria.title: 비선형 convolution과 dealiasing
criteria.text:
모든p+q=k 상호작용을계산한다. quadratic product는3/2 padding 또는그와동등한정확한retained-mode convolu-
tion을사용한다. 합격: 작은random solenoidal fixture에서direct convolution과FFT product가정규화10^−11 이내
일치한다. high-mode aliasing negative control이검출된다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
criteria.acceptanceScope: All retained direct convolution interactions and the separately implemented padded FFT remain compared below1e-11. The high-mode aliasing omission is rejected, and independent NumPy output is preserved. The observation changes do not alter this numerical kernel.

criteria.title: 시간 적응과 에너지 안정성
criteria.text:
diffusion integrating factor/IMEX 등으로stiff linear term을처리하고advection CFL·embedded local error·energy
defect로step을승인한다. 합격: Taylor-Green의amplitude/energy를시간반분에서설계차수로수렴시킨다. dt를줄여
도사라지지않는energy defect는spatial/aliasing 오류로조사한다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
criteria.acceptanceScope: The existing IMEX method retains advection CFL, embedded step doubling and energy-defect acceptance. Taylor-Green amplitude and energy show the intended second-order time refinement, independently checked with NumPy. New path integration has its own distinct error estimate and does not substitute for the solver acceptance gate.

criteria.title: τ 기반 near-terminal sampling
criteria.text:
s=−logτ를주변수로쓰고τ>0만평가한다. normalized coordinates와velocity를계산한뒤physical scaling을적용한다.
합격: τ=10^−2,10^−4,10^−8,10^−12 예시와더작은값의precision mode가재현된다. 표시t가1로반올림돼도내
부τ>0 계약은유지한다.
criteria.assessedBy: Root original-criterion review of actual source gates and exact support proof
criteria.acceptanceScope: The original three-component near-terminal intervals are now bound to the same final localized field on the checked original core restriction. The consumer independently revalidates the recorded inner/domain/near-terminal sources and executes the new support induction, matching source binding, Xin/Y/eta, qStar and all five unit-plateau rows. The exact identity s=-log(tau), strictly positive internal tau, three separate physical scale formulas, source depths0/2/4/8/12 and the requested decimal examples plus smaller precision examples are retained. Decimal examples in the genuine initial zero interval are explicitly distinguished from the nonzero source-depth intervals. A displayed t rounded to1 never sets internal tau to0. The original10-test/38-check near-terminal gate and new16-test/41-check source-core proof reproduce these values. This completes near-terminal sampling on the original core path; it does not complete an arbitrary-coordinate annular evaluator or the independent N8-05 adaptation/tail requirements.

criteria.text:

global energy를구분한다. 합격: 모든scene은실제run hash·샘플위치·단위·색범위·vector scale를갖는다. 자동확대나
vector 정규화가core 수축·성장을숨기지않는다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
criteria.acceptanceScope: Actual finite-run observations preserve81 sample positions/vectors, fixed physical bounds, separately declared normalized periodic coordinates, fixed vector scale and common color bounds. Published v93 controls and exact selections verified instantaneous streamlines/coefficient-history particle paths, velocity/axis-dependent angular velocity (undefined on axis), and whole-box Parseval/fixed-core midpoint energy. Input/source/result and archive replay remain bound. This is the finite flow/display criterion; no original near-terminal field or complete source reconstruction is inferred. The earlier v85 liveVerification remains a historical receipt.
